  "reasons": [
    "Because the directors have not made the call, the payment is in advance. The source says it is a liability credited to Calls in Advance Account.",
    "No calculation is needed; Rs 5,000 does not affect the accounting classification."
  ],
  "syllabus_chapter": "Share Capital",
  "syllabus_topic": "Calls in advance: accounting treatment and presentation as a liability.",

      "condition": "The payment is received toward a call before the directors have made that call.",
      "status": "explicit",
      "alters_key_if_changed": true,
      "convention_evidence_ids": []
    }
  ],
  "option_challenges": [
    {
      "option": "A",
      "strongest_reading": "If the amount were already called-up capital, it might be credited to Share Capital; the stem instead says the call has not yet been made.",
      "correct_under_reading": false,
      "reading_status": "contradicts_stem",
      "convention_evidence_ids": []
    },
    {
      "option": "B",
      "strongest_reading": "If a call had been made and remained unpaid when due, arrears might apply; the stem says the call has not yet been made.",
      "correct_under_reading": false,
      "reading_status": "contradicts_stem",
      "convention_evidence_ids": []
    },
    {
      "option": "D",
      "strongest_reading": "If the payment were a securities premium rather than money toward an unmade call, this treatment might fit; the stem identifies it as a call payment.",
      "correct_under_reading": false,
      "reading_status": "contradicts_stem",
      "convention_evidence_ids": []
    }
  ],

  "option_resolution": [
    {
      "option": "A",
      "status": "contradicted",
      "false_part": "Credit it to Share Capital A/c immediately and treat it as part of owners' equity",
      "premise_source": "excerpt",
      "evidence_id": "E1.1",
      "premise_quote": "The amount received in advance is a liability of the company and should be credited to ‘Call in Advance Account.”",
      "reason": "The source requires liability treatment and credit to Calls in Advance, not immediate credit to Share Capital as owners’ equity."
    },
    {
      "option": "B",
      "status": "contradicted",
      "false_part": "Credit it to Calls in Arrears A/c",
      "premise_source": "excerpt",
      "evidence_id": "E2.1",
      "premise_quote": "When any shareholder fails to pay the amount due on allotment or on any of the calls, such amount is known as ‘Calls in Arrears’/‘Unpaid Calls’.",
      "reason": "Arrears concern an unpaid amount due; the stem says the directors have not yet made this call."
    },
    {
      "option": "C",
      "status": "supported",
      "false_part": "",
      "premise_source": "excerpt",
      "evidence_id": "E1.1",
      "premise_quote": "The amount received in advance is a liability of the company and should be credited to ‘Call in Advance Account.”",
      "reason": "The excerpt gives the Calls in Advance credit and liability treatment; the amount is adjusted when calls become due."
    },
    {
      "option": "D",
      "status": "contradicted",
      "false_part": "Credit it to Securities Premium Reserve A/c as a capital reserve of the company",
      "premise_source": "excerpt",
      "evidence_id": "E1.1",
      "premise_quote": "The amount received in advance is a liability of the company and should be credited to ‘Call in Advance Account.”",
      "reason": "The source classifies this advance as a liability credited to Calls in Advance, not as a securities premium reserve."
    }
  ]
